text: The ad5d66d phase removes the messageWindowDocShell getter together with nsMsgWindow’s nsIURIContentListener exposure and forwarding methods. The removed DoContent code could set the mailnews URL window and delegate to the docshell listener; the old getter warned against retaining its docshell. The patch provides no replacement routing path or direct tests. Its transactionManager survives this phase and is moved separately later. The accepted empty interface is therefore a later combined state, not proof that this one patch removed all remaining state or preserved native behavior.
title: The messageWindowDocShell removal also removes nsMsgWindow URI-content-listener support
